summary: BI-3DD6EFEB (EP-MILEAGE-ABSORB). Migration 20261114170000_trip_manual_coordinates_optional drops NOT NULL from Trip.startLatitude, startLongitude, endLatitude and endLongitude, so a drive a person types into the portal stores its unknown position as NULL instead of a fabricated 0,0. Mileage rates are written by a person into the existing MileageRatePlan / MileageRate tables; no table or column is added.
affectedCopies: Trip: four columns become nullable. Every existing row keeps its coordinates; only captureKind manual rows written by the portal carry NULL.
MileageRatePlan / MileageRate: no schema change. A person with manage_finance now creates the company plan and rates from /finance/mileage.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: Trip coordinates are location data about a driver and stay governed as such. This change only allows LESS of it: a manual drive stores no position at all.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: Unchanged. Manual drives are deleted and exported with the driver's other trips.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Relaxing NOT NULL on location fields reduces collection; no new personal data is stored.

migration.name: 20261114170000_trip_manual_coordinates_optional
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Restoring NOT NULL would first require deleting or capturing positions for manual drives, which must not be fabricated.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Unchanged: trips keep their existing lifecycle and retention. Nullability only.

fields.reason: Existing location field, now nullable for typed-in drives. Governance and protection unchanged.
